title: Extension bridge frame envelope
description: The envelope of every frame on the per-document MessageChannel port between the shared browser observation runtime and the extension's main-world bridge. The per-kind payload contracts are owned by extension-protocol/bridge-page-proof/v1, bridge-target-query/v1, bridge-target-geometry/v1, bridge-detail-query/v1 and bridge-pause-notice/v1; this schema states which envelope the SDK speaks and deliberately does not restate those payloads. A request and its answer share the same kind (except target_query, answered by target_geometry) and the same exchange_id. No credential crosses this port and product telemetry never travels over it.

schema_version.$comment: fixed-literal: the decimal contract major, not a vocabulary name.

payload.$comment: extension-point: the per-kind payload is owned by the extension-protocol bridge schemas.
